name: furrow-forms
description: A form backend your agent can run end to end — provision forms, spam, email, and signed webhooks for any site.
long_description: Furrow Forms is the form backend for vibe-coded and static websites. Claude can register the account, provision a site's forms in one bootstrap_site call, generate the frontend snippet (honeypot and timing field included), and verify HMAC-signed webhook delivery — no dashboard required. 26 tools cover the whole product.

token.title: Furrow Forms API token
token.description: frw_… token from app.furrowforms.com → Settings → Tokens. Leave blank to sign in with OAuth.
